gaps.problem: When handed a non-generator iterator (iter(list), map, filter, itertools objects), the first two items are silently dropped: `islice(values, 2)` consumes them and the re-chaining guard only fires for `isinstance(values, GeneratorType)`. Byte-identical to upstream, and unreachable from NativeTemplate.render/render_async (which pass a generator or a list), so it is NOT a spec gap - reported only as a latent defect in a public documented function whose parameter is annotated `t.Iterable[t.Any]`.

gaps.problem: Two latent defects that are byte-identical to upstream, therefore not spec gaps. (1) install_gettext_callables() without pgettext/npgettext stores `None` into environment.globals, so a later `{% trans "ctx" %}` raises `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not callable` instead of a template error. (2) get_template_locals skips any `l_<depth>_<name>` whose value is `missing` before building local_overrides, so the later `if value is missing: data.pop(name, None)` branch is unreachable and a template variable deleted at a deeper scope still shows its outer value in the rewritten traceback frame's locals.
